home.headline: Quiet on the outside. A story on the inside.
home.intro: Tailored work bags for city days, with textile woven by hand in Vietnam.
home.trust: Inspect before you pay · Studio visits by appointment
home.collectionTitle: Three ways to carry your day.
home.collectionBody: Essential for everyday. Signature for a flap that closes and a woven band you notice. Heritage for the full woven lining.
home.revealOne: A body cut from new technical textile.
home.revealTwo: Handles and flaps in recovered cotton, denim and synthetics.
home.materialOne: New technical textile: dense jacquard canvas and felt, for a body that holds its shape and wears well.
home.materialTwo: Recovered cotton, denim and synthetics, used for handles, flaps, straps and the scarf.
home.materialNote: Measured by textile weight. Every part is listed on each product page.
home.trustOne: Open the parcel and check your bag before paying the courier.
home.trustTwo: Handles, buckles and seams can come back to us for repair.
home.trustThree: Book a time and try any bag at our studio on Le Quy Don.
home.studioBody: 22 Le Quy Don, Hai Ba Trung Ward, Hanoi. Open every day, 8:00 to 21:30, by appointment.
